title: Wholesome Girlies vs Babymigo: First Pregnancy in Nigeria
description: Compare Wholesome Girlies and Babymigo for a first pregnancy in Nigeria. See their classes, tools, prices and ways to prepare for antenatal visits.
share: If you are choosing between Babymigo and Wholesome Girlies for a first pregnancy, this comparison shows their classes, tools, Nigerian prices and antenatal help.
kicker: For women preparing for their first pregnancy in Nigeria
answer: If you want to find a hospital or a lactation consultant near you, ask other mothers and doctors a question, or join a live online antenatal class, use Babymigo. If you want a week-by-week plan for your first pregnancy, use Wholesome Girlies. Our First Pregnancy Plan explains what is normal each week, what you can eat, what your scans mean and when to call the doctor. You can also print a list of questions to take to each antenatal visit. You can use both, and we do not claim our advice is better than Babymigo's.

image.alt: Illustration of Zainab, pregnant, looking at a week-by-week chart

disclaimer.strong: This page compares a parenting forum and a plan. It cannot tell you what is normal for your pregnancy.
disclaimer.rest: It is educational, not medical advice, and no clinician has reviewed it yet.

doctor: See a doctor or go to hospital if you have bleeding, severe or persistent pain, fever, vomiting so severe you cannot keep fluids down, a bad headache with blurred vision, sudden swelling of the face and hands, or fluid leaking. If you are unsure, call. Nobody minds a call that turns out to be nothing.
legend: A tick means that option does this better. We only use a tick when our tools or a source on this page supports it.

rows.label: What can I use it for?
rows.wg: Use the pregnancy tools and guides as you need them. The First Pregnancy Plan guides you week by week.
rows.other: Ask questions in Babymigo's forum, read articles, use tools, find Nigerian providers or join PreggClass online.

rows.label: Will it guide me week by week?
rows.wg: Yes. The First Pregnancy Plan shows what is happening to you and your baby each week, which symptoms need a call, what you can eat, what your scans and tests mean, and how to get ready for birth and the first days.
rows.other: You can use its week-by-week page, articles, forum discussions and classes.

rows.label: What does it cost me?
rows.wg: The tools need no card. The First Pregnancy Plan is one payment of ₦5,700 early-bird (₦13,700 standard), or $12 early-bird ($27 standard) abroad. There is no subscription and nothing to cancel.
rows.other: The forum, articles, tools and directory show no price. PreggClass costs ₦10,000 (about $7.50) a class, beside ₦20,500 (about $15) struck through.

rows.label: Do I have to sign up?
rows.wg: No. The Due Date Calculator works out your due date. The Week-by-Week Tracker shows your pregnancy week. Antenatal Appointment Questions gives you a list to tick, add to and print. The Safe Foods Checklist covers Nigerian foods that are generally safe in pregnancy, including moi moi, ugu and beans.
rows.other: No sign-in to read or search the directory. Sign in with Gmail to post. You can also use Facebook or email. You can ask anonymously.

rows.label: Where are my dates kept?
rows.wg: Your due date and weekly tracker date stay on your phone. We do not receive them.
rows.other: Babymigo says it may ask for your due date, location, phone number and email. Its words appear below.

rows.label: Can I prepare questions for my doctor?
rows.wg: Use Antenatal Appointment Questions to tick questions, add your own and print the list for your visit.
rows.other: Ask on the forum and read replies from other women and doctors.

rows.label: Does it cover life in Nigeria?
rows.wg: Yes. It covers the Nigerian foods you actually eat, like jollof, suya, local fish and zobo, and our guides answer questions like whether tiger nut, bitter kola and cloves are safe in pregnancy. Prices are in naira and dollars.
rows.other: It lists providers in Lagos, Abuja, Ibadan, Port Harcourt, Kano, Calabar and Kaduna. Ghana and Kenya also appear in its header.

rows.label: Can I find a provider near me?
rows.wg: No. We do not have a provider directory.
rows.other: Yes. It lists 50+ breastfeeding consultants, 1000+ maternity hospitals and 5000+ creches and day care centres across Nigerian states.

rows.label: Can I ask other women and doctors?
rows.wg: Anyone can join our open Telegram group for tips, polls and app help. Program buyers also get a private community.
rows.other: Yes. Babymigo says it has 250,000+ members and replies from mothers and doctors. It does not guarantee that user replies are correct.

rows.label: Can I join a live class?
rows.wg: No. The First Pregnancy Plan has no live class.
rows.other: Yes. Babymigo says a trained and board certified gynaecologist, paediatrician or midwife leads PreggClass online.

wins.h: You know what to do each week
wins.b: The First Pregnancy Plan takes you from your first weeks to the first days at home with your baby. It tells you which symptoms are common, which need a call and which mean you go in. It explains your scans and tests, covers labour, the hospital bag and your birth plan, and you join a moderated community of women at your stage for life. Put it to use, and if it is still not right for you, you can ask for a full refund within 30 days.
The Plan is ₦5,700 early-bird (₦13,700 standard), paid once, or $12 early-bird ($27 standard) abroad. There is no subscription and nothing to cancel.

wins.h: Food advice for what you actually eat
wins.b: The Plan covers jollof, suya, local fish, zobo and herbal mixtures. The Safe Foods Checklist covers moi moi, ugu and beans, and our guide answers whether tiger nut, bitter kola and cloves are safe in pregnancy.

wins.h: The tools need no account and no card
wins.b: The pregnancy tools open with no sign-in and no payment step. The Birth Plan Builder makes a one-page birth plan for your midwife or doctor. The Hospital Bag Checklist covers your hospital bag. The Newborn Essentials Checklist lists baby essentials. The Plan opens with the email you paid with.

wins.h: Your dates stay on your phone
wins.b: Your date stays on your phone when you use the due date calculator or weekly tracker. We do not receive it.

wins.h: Questions to print for the clinic
wins.b: Antenatal Appointment Questions lets you tick, add your own and print.

wins.h: A new phone, and no data needed
wins.b: Save a backup puts your saved entries in one file. Restore a backup moves that file to a new phone. Email sign-in moves your programs and streak, the count of days you use Wholesome Girlies in a row. It never moves your dates.

wins.h: Something short for your pregnancy week
wins.b: Today's card is a one or two sentence note on the Girlies app home for your pregnancy week. It links to the tool or guide behind it. Under your due date result, you can ask for a weekly pregnancy email.

wins.h: It stays with you after the birth
wins.b: Wholesome Girlies also covers the weeks after the birth and raising your child, so the same Girlies app keeps working for you once your baby arrives.

other_ahead.b: Babymigo has a directory with 50+ breastfeeding consultants, 1000+ maternity hospitals and 5000+ creches and day care centres, by its own pages. We have no directory.

Its forum has more than 250,000 members, by Babymigo's own count, and questions get answers from other mothers and doctors. Our open Telegram group is smaller, and our private community is for program buyers.
PreggClass is an online antenatal class at ₦10,000 (about $7.50) a class. The First Pregnancy Plan has no live class.

picks.b: if you want to find a hospital, a lactation consultant or a day care, ask other women a question, or take a live class.
if you want a due date, a week by week view and questions for your visit with no account, and your dates on your phone.
if you want five clear parts to follow and a community that you pay for once.
if you want Babymigo's directory and forum alongside the Plan.

faq.a: Babymigo's own page shows PreggClass for individuals, partners or couples at ₦10,000 (about $7.50) a class, beside ₦20,500 (about $15) struck through. The corporate plan shows no price. It is a class, and The First Pregnancy Plan is a plan, so the two are different products.

faq.q: How many members does Babymigo have?
faq.a: Its home page says "Join 250,000+ members". That is Babymigo's own count.

faq.q: Does the Wholesome Girlies Plan need an account?
faq.a: The tools need no account and no card. The Plan opens when you sign in with the email you paid with. We send a sign-in link to that email.
Yes. Use Babymigo's directory and forum, and use the Wholesome Girlies tools and The First Pregnancy Plan for the week by week plan and the questions for your visit.
No. It is educational, not medical advice. The Plan says when a symptom belongs with your doctor.
